title: feat: add audio transcription to MCP
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `transcribeAudio` to the existing Pollinations MCP instead of deploying another Worker
- Fetches a direct public HTTPS audio URL and forwards it unchanged as multipart to `/v1/audio/transcriptions`
- Leaves model validation, provider limits, and request timing to Gen; adds no MCP timeout, size cap, retry, or fallback
- Publishes `@pollinations/mcp` 2.5.0 and covers hosted and stdio registration

Tests: focused audio tests, modern/legacy stdio suite, hosted MCP Worker suite

gist.headline: The hive has ears
gist.blurb: Pollinations MCP can now take a public audio URL and turn the buzzing into text. No extra Worker habitat required.
gist.summary: Added a transcribeAudio tool to @pollinations/mcp 2.5.0, which fetches a direct public HTTPS audio URL and forwards it unchanged as multipart to Gen's /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint.
gist.impact: MCP agents using either hosted or stdio registration can now request audio transcription through the existing Pollinations MCP server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the existing Pollinations MCP as a cozy retro terminal receiving a small audio cassette or sound-wave postcard from a public URL, then printing a neat transcription page. Polli, wearing tiny studio headphones, listens warmly beside the terminal while a code-plant grows text-shaped leaves, representing audio passing through the existing MCP path rather than needing a separate service.
